sources.title: How to Visit Leifeng Pagoda - Hangzhou Travel
sources.content:
Leifeng Pagoda Visitor Guide

Location & Access
Leifeng Pagoda sits on Sunset Hill south of West Lake in Hangzhou, at 15 Nanshan Rd, Xihu, Hangzhou. Visitors can reach it via buses No. 4, 31, 315, 507H, 1314, 5, or 2, exiting at Jingsi Temple Station where the pagoda stands opposite.

Hours & Admission
Seasonal Hours:
- Nov 1–Mar 15: 8:00-17:30 (tickets until 17:00)
- Mar 16–Apr 30: 8:00-19:00 (tickets until 18:30)
- May 1–Oct 31: 8:00-20:00 (tickets until 19:30)
Cost: 40 RMB per person

Historical Background
Originally constructed in 975 AD from brick and wood, the structure survived until the Ming dynasty when Japanese pirates destroyed its wooden portions. The original tower collapsed in September 1924 due to deterioration. Reconstruction began in 1999, with the newly rebuilt pagoda opening October 25, 2002.

Modern Facilities
The contemporary structure features four sightseeing elevators, air conditioning, television, and speakers. An escalator transports visitors to the pagoda's foundation, preserving the original brick base visible beneath the modern construction.

Nearby Attractions
From the upper levels, visitors enjoy panoramic views of West Lake, the Jinci Temple to the south, Huagang Park westward, and Hangzhou's urban skyline toward the northeast.

sources.title: Leifeng Pagoda, a famous pagoda hangzhou
sources.content:
Leifeng Pagoda Content Extract

Overview
Leifeng Pagoda is a five story tall tower with eight sides, located on Sunset Hill south of the West Lake in Hangzhou. Originally built in AD 975, it collapsed in 1924 and was rebuilt in 2002.

Historical Background
The pagoda was constructed at the order of Qian Hongchu, King of Wuyue Kingdom, to celebrate his son's birth. Initially called Huangfei Pagoda, it was also known as the Brick Pagoda of West Gate. The structure featured octagonal design with five stories, constructed from brick and wood with stone inscriptions of Huayan Scriptures on inner walls.

Cultural Significance
The pagoda gained fame through "The Legend of the White Snake," a popular folk tale about a snake girl imprisoned beneath the structure. Lu Xun, a prestigious Chinese literary figure, wrote about its 1924 collapse as symbolizing the end of feudalistic order.

Historical Damage
During the Ming Dynasty's Jiaqing years (1522-66), Japanese invaders burned wooden components. Superstitious individuals later removed bricks believing them medicinal. Finally, in August 1924 the foot of the pagoda was dug hollow, leading to collapse.

Buddhist Relics
The pagoda housed hair and skeletal remains of Sakyamuni. In March of 2001, a number of ancient Buddhist relics were unearthed from underground chambers.

Reconstruction
Completed in October 2002, the new structure features steel framework with brick inlay and upturned eaves, maintaining traditional aesthetics.

Visitor Information
Admission: CNY 40 (children under 1.3m: CNY 20)
Hours: 8:00-17:30 (Nov 16-Mar 14); 7:30-21:00 (Mar 15-Nov 15)
Transportation: Accessible via taxi or buses K4, K504, K514, K808, 822, Y1-Y3, Y6-Y7, Y9

sources.title: Complete Guide to Visiting Hangzhou's Leifeng Pagoda
sources.content:
Complete Guide to Visiting Hangzhou's Leifeng Pagoda

At the entrance of the pagoda, there are two autonomous escalators to carry visitors to the base of the pagoda. It contains four sightseeing elevators, and modern amenities such as air conditioning.

After climbing to the observation deck, visitors watch as golden afternoon light transforms West Lake into a mirror of amber and bronze.

Inside, the legend of the white snake is revisited through wooden carvings. During renovations in 2001, Buddhist scriptures written on silk were discovered in the foundations, along with other treasures.

Visit in winter (December to February) or from late November to mid-December, which have fewer tourists, with early mornings or weekdays being the best times to avoid crowds. Most people spend about 1.5 to 2 hours at Leifeng Pagoda.

Buy tickets in advance during peak tourist seasons to avoid long queues. Wear comfortable shoes as there's a fair amount of walking and climbing steps involved. Take the elevator to the highest floor for stunning views without the strenuous climb!

sources.title: Leifeng Pagoda Of West Lake, Hangzhou: Tour Tips & FAQs 2026
sources.content:
Leifeng Pagoda Of West Lake, Hangzhou: Tour Tips & FAQs 2026

Leifeng Pagoda stands majestically on Sunset Hill south of West Lake in Hangzhou, China, rising 71.7 meters tall with an octagonal tower offering panoramic views of West Lake and the surrounding landscape.

The current structure, rebuilt in 2002, replaced the original pagoda from the Northern Song Dynasty (977 AD). The pagoda is tied to the legend of the White Snake, a famous Chinese folktale.

Best Time to Visit: To avoid crowds, consider visiting during weekdays or early mornings. The pagoda is particularly beautiful during sunset and when illuminated at night.

Opening Hours: 8:00 AM–5:30 PM (November–March), 8:00 AM–8:00 PM (April–October).

Inside, you'll find five themed floors showcasing different aspects of the pagoda's significance. The basement houses archaeological discoveries from the original structure. The upper levels contain multimedia exhibitions telling the story of the pagoda and the Lady White Snake legend.

Hop on the red circular bus (¥30/day unlimited rides) stopping at 13 key spots like Broken Bridge, Su Causeway, and Leifeng Pagoda.

sources.title: 雷峰塔_百度百科
sources.content:
雷峰塔完整信息汇总

基本信息
雷峰塔位于浙江省杭州市西湖区南山路15号，初名皇妃塔，又名西关砖塔、黄妃塔。总高71.679米，占地面积3133平方米，建筑面积6089平方米。

历史沿革
始建：北宋太平兴国二年（977年），吴越国王钱俶为供奉佛螺髻发舍利、祈求国泰民安而建，初为7层。
损毁：北宋宣和二年（1120年）因战乱毁于兵火。南宋乾道七年（1171年）被重修为八面五层。明嘉靖年间木结构檐廊毁于兵燹。民国十三年（1924年）9月25日因塔砖盗挖过多而倒坍。
重建：2000年12月16日重建工程启动，2002年10月25日竣工并对外开放。

建筑结构
主体为平面八角形仿唐宋楼阁式塔，各层盖铜瓦，转角处设铜斗拱，飞檐翘角。构成：台基两层（含地下一层）、塔身五层（含暗层）、塔刹。为"塔中之塔"结构，最大程度保护了古塔遗址。

重要景点
一层：正门悬启功题写的"雷峰塔"金匾，地面使用玻璃铺装
暗层：东阳木雕描绘白蛇传故事
二层：《吴越造塔图》
三层：四块诗刻，共12首诗词
四层：瓯塑陈设西湖十景景观
五层：金色穹顶，中央为莲花，墙壁有2002座金涂塔

遗址
地宫位于塔基正中，开口于塔心室地坪下2.6米，单室砖砌，上有方形石盖板，重七百公斤巨石覆压。

出土文物
"开元通宝"玉钱、"都省铜坊"镜（直径17厘米，出土最大铜镜）、"千秋万岁"铭鎏金银盒（通高14厘米，腹径20.7厘米，通体鎏金，胎壁厚仅0.1厘米）

相关文化
雷峰夕照：西湖十景之一。每当夕阳西照，塔影横空，亭台金碧。
白蛇传：白素贞因触犯天条被法海镇压于塔下，后被儿子救出。
金砖传说：疯和尚赠张阿水经砖，村民误以为是"金砖"，纷纷来塔砖"淘金"。

获得荣誉
2003年：教育部优秀勘察设计一等奖
2005年：全国第十一届优秀工程设计银奖、全国优秀建筑创作大奖
中国首座彩色铜雕宝塔

旅游信息
门票：40元/人
开放时间：11月1日-3月15日 8:00-17:30；3月16日-4月30日 8:00-19:00；5月1日-10月31日 8:00-20:00
交通：公交4路、31路、139路、582路、1314路、西湖内环线、西湖外环线等可达

sources.title: 杭州雷峰塔旅游攻略（开放时间+门票+地址交通）
sources.content:
杭州雷峰塔旅游攻略

景点介绍
雷峰塔景区地处浙江省杭州市西湖南岸的夕照山，公元977年由吴越国王钱俶为供奉佛螺髻发、祈求国泰民安而建造。雷峰新塔于2000年12月26日奠基，2002年10月25日如期落成。

门票价格
成人门票40元。6周岁(不含)—18周岁(含)未成年人、全日制大学本科及以下学历学生凭有效证件购买半票20元。70周岁以上老人、30年教龄荣誉证书、现役军人、离休干部凭有效证件半票20元。儿童身高1.2米以下免费；残疾人、残疾军人凭有效证件免票。

开放时间
8:00—20:30（3月中旬—11月中旬）；8:00—17:30（11月中旬—3月中旬）。

交通方式
可乘坐4路、31路、315路、1314路等公交线路，到净寺公交站下车步行前往。

游玩建议
建议在雷峰塔闭园前1小时进，人少且光线柔和，可以在夕照山观景台拍雷峰夕照。可以在景区游客中心请导游讲解，仅塔区50元/场，整个雷峰塔景区为80元/场。

sources.title: Leifeng Pagoda | Hangzhou, China - Lonely Planet
sources.content:
Leifeng Pagoda - Lonely Planet

Leifeng Pagoda is a five-story, eight-sided tower located on Sunset Hill south of West Lake in Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China. Originally constructed in the year AD 975, it collapsed in 1924 but was rebuilt in 2002.

After climbing to the observation deck, visitors watch as golden afternoon light transforms West Lake into a mirror of amber and bronze, with elderly local gentlemen quietly reciting portions of the White Snake legend.

The pagoda offers stunning sunset views over West Lake and is one of the most iconic landmarks in Hangzhou.
